senses.gloss:
लेख, अस्, m. [cf. रेख], a writing, letter, epistle,
manuscript, document, written document of any kind,
(कूट-लेख, a spurious or forged document); a
god, deity; a proper N.; (आ), f. a scratch, streak,
line, (गण्ड-लेखा, ‘cheek-line,’ the outline of the
cheek; cf. विद्युल्-ल्˚); stripe, stroke, furrow, row,
groove; writing, handwriting, drawing lines, deline-
ation, drawing, painting; a drawing, likeness, repre-
sentation, figure, impression, mark; the curved line
or pale streak of the young moon (when only faintly
discernible), the moon's crescent; hem, border, rim,
brim, edge, the horizon; = शिखा, चूडाग्र; (आस्),
m. pl., N. of a class of gods under Manu Cākṣuṣa.
—लेख-पत्त्र, अम्, n. or लेख-पत्त्रिका, f. a
written document, writing, letter, epistle; writ, deed.
—लेख-प्रतिलेख-लिपि, इस्, f. a particular kind of
writing.
—लेखर्षभ (˚ख-ऋष्), अस्, m. ‘best
of deities, ‘N. of Indra.
—लेख-सन्देश-हारिन्, ई,
इणी, इ, taking or conveying a written message or
instructions.
—लेख-हार or लेख-हारक, अस्,
m. a letter-carrier, the bearer of a letter.
—लेख-
हारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, taking or conveying a letter.
—ले-
खाक्षर (˚ख-अक्˚), अम्, n. writing, (opposed to
आलेख्य, painting.)
—लेखाधिकारिन् (˚ख-अध्˚),
ई, m. ‘presiding over written documents,’ a king's
secretary.
—लेखाभ्र (˚ख-अभ्˚), अस्, m., N. of
a man; (आस्), m. pl. his descendants.
—लेखा-भ्रू,
ऊस्, f., N. of a woman.
—लेखार्ह (˚ख-अर्˚), अस्,
m. ‘fit for writing on,’ a kind of palm tree (the
leaves of which are used for writing on).
—लेखा-
वलय, अस्, अम्, m. n. an encircling line.

लेख लेख, लेखन, लेखिन्, लेख्य, &c.
See p. 866, cols. 2, 3.

लेखक, अस्, m. a writer, scribe, copyist, clerk,
amanuensis, secretary; one who delineates or paints;
writing down, transcribing, (in this sense perhaps
अम्, n.)
—लेखक-प्रमाद, अस्, m. an error or
mistake of a copyist.
—लेखक-मुक्ता-मणि, इस्,
m. ‘pearl-gem for scribes,’ N. of a treatise on the
art of writing by Hari-dāsa (especially intended for
scribes belonging to a royal court).

लेखन, अस्, ई, अम्, scratching, scraping, scarify-
[]
ing, making an incision, lancing; writing; exciting,
stimulating; (अस्), m. Saccharum Spontaneum, a sort
of grass or reed of which pens are made; (ई), f. an
instrument for writing, a writing-reed, pen, style,
(also written लेखनि when required by the metre);
a spoon, ladle; (अम्), n. the act of scratching or
scraping; cutting or making incisions (in surgery);
scarifying; the act of writing or writing down, tran-
scribing, copying; scripture; an instrument or im-
plement for scraping or furrowing; a kind of birch
the bark of which is used for writing on [cf. भूर्ज],
the leaf of the palm tree used for the same purpose;
grazing, touching, coming in contact (said of heavenly
bodies); thinning, attenuating, reducing corpulency.
—लेखन-वस्ति, इस्, f. a kind of clyster or enema
for thinning or reducing corpulency.
—लेखन-सा-
धन, अम्, n. writing materials.

लेखनिक, अस्, m. one who makes another sign
a document instead of himself, signing by proxy, or
making a mark (from inability to write); the bearer
of a letter, a letter-carrier, postman, express.

लेखनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be written; to be drawn
or painted; serving as a scraper or as a lancet, &c.;
(अम्), n. an accusation or defence in law (required to
be given in writing) .

लेखाय, Nom. P. लेखायति, &c., to be wanton,
sport wantonly; to waver, totter, stumble, slip.
लेखित, अस्, आ, अम्, scratched, written, &c.

लेखिन्, ई, इनी, इ, scratching, scraping; writing;
grazing, touching; (इनी), f. a spoon, ladle.

1. लेख्य, Nom. P. लेख्यति, &c., = लेखाय
above.

2. लेख्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be scratched or scraped,
to be scarified; to be written or transcribed, proper
to be written; to be drawn or painted; portrayed,
painted; to be written down or numbered among
(loc.); (अम्), n. writing, the art of writing; copying,
transcribing; delineation, drawing, painting; a writ-
ing, document, letter, manuscript; a written accusa-
tion or defence; an inscription; a painted figure.
—लेख्य-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, done in writing, signed,
executed.
—लेख्य-गत, अस्, आ, अम्, represented
in painting, painted.
—लेख्य-चूर्णिका, f. a writing-
pencil, drawing-pencil, paint-brush.
—लेख्य-पत्त्र
or लेख्य-पत्त्रक, अस्, m. the palmyra or palm
tree; (अम्), n. a palm leaf for writing on; a written
paper, writing, letter.
—लेख्य-प्रसङ्ग, अस्, m.
a written contract, record, document.
—लेख्य-
मय, अस्, ई, अम्, delineated, painted.
—लेख्य-
स्थान, अम्, n. a writing place, office.
—लेख्या-
रूढ (˚य-आर्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, committed to writing,
recorded.
लेख्यक, अस्, आ, अम्, written, epistolary.
